newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Q3 foreign debt slips to 33.8 pct/GDP - Ortiz.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Q3 foreign debt slips to 33.8 pct/GDP - Ortiz.

text.p: Mexican Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz said Friday that total foreign debt was 33.8 percent of gross domestic product in the third quarter, an improving situation that he also said was reflected in lower amortizations.
"That figure is much less than we had at the end of 1994 ... and the end of 1995," Ortiz told a Congressional hearing on the 1997 budget.
He said interest payments in 1997 would be less than seven percent of expected total exports, down from 7.6 percent this year.

He also said amortizations of public debt in 1997 would fall to $9 billion from $16 billion in 1996, though they are expected to rebound again to $10 billion in 1998. But in coming years the amortizations would remain manageable, he said.
